notes.title: 1.0 is coming soon
notes.content:
Annnnnnnnd we're back! 

After a long hiatus it's time to give the PC version of ZWG a little (lot?) of love. The last few months have been focused on the mobile release of the game. I'm certainly glad to have put ZWG out for the iOS and Android platforms, but holy smokes was that a lot of work. 

It's time to get back and focus on my fellow PC gamers. 

[h1]DO IT LIVE![/h1]
With that being said, I'm excited to announce that ZWG will be going live just as soon as Valve approves the 1.0 build. 

[h1]Keyboard Mode[/h1]

No need to click! Now you can use your keyboard to type out the word you're looking to build. Some special keys to note:
[list]
[*] <backspace> to delete the last letter in the current word
[*] <space> to clear the entire current word
[*] <shift> Hold down shift to replace the last letter in the word. Press <shift>+<letter> repeatedly to cycle through different instances of a letter on the game board. 
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome to the Zim's Word Game Community
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Zim's Word Game! [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922352/9a7bdc3c34917be8a9eb94bb605040d8037f8c54.png[/img]

Today I'm excited to finally have this page live and be able to share regular development updates with the community. If this is your first time reading about Zim's Word Game (ZWG), an extra special hello to you! ZWG is a fast-paced word game where you use falling letters to craft the highest scoring words possible. As you level up, the tiles start spawning faster. When a column is full of tiles and a new tile can't be spawned in that column - the game is over. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922352/0c4a464c8dfdbc758c8b715d351e7faf71e843b4.png[/img]

[h2]Current Status[/h2]
The game is currently going through private internal alpha testing. 

What does "internal alpha" mean?
- Core game mechanics are in place
- Not every feature has been added
- Features that are currently finished are rough around the edges

[b]Current Feature Development[/b]
Beyond the core gameplay experience, additional "special tiles" are what adds some fun spice to ZWG. We're currently testing out a "fire", "ice", and "steel" tile type (shown below). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922352/d5ab05b69115c5302088ef911e0ecf5ca4cdc5f7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922352/d55a2f3c44068b503a31fdc2fc07eb0389c832a3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42922352/739e87854fbdd21ec13ab87c9dadb138ce5a9b63.png[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
[i]Code, release, test, repeat! [/i]

While the development cycle continues, I'll be posting here with updates on features, progress, and the occasional live stream to show off the current progress of the game. In addition to the work mentioned above, enhanced Steam Leaderboard functionality is what is on the roadmap for "what's next". 

[h3]"Sounds cool, how can I help?"[/h3]
Glad you asked! The best thing you can do right now is add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/789450/Zims_Word_Game/]Zim's Word Game[/url] to your Wish List by clicking the "Add to wishlist" button on the store page. In addition, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/789450#]follow[/url] the community site to keep up to date with my developer blogs, live streams, and announcements. 

Game on!
~Zim
